title: Metastatic bone tumor（转移性骨肿瘤）

properties.disease overview: Secondary malignant involvement of bone from a primary cancer (commonly lung, breast, prostate, kidney, thyroid); frequently affects spine and pelvis and can cause severe pain, pathological fracture, and neurological compression.
properties.mechanism: Hematogenous spread of malignant cells to bone marrow–rich, well-perfused sites (especially axial skeleton); lesions may be lytic, blastic, or mixed and can destabilize bone and compress neural structures.
properties.disorder: Metastatic bone tumor（转移性骨肿瘤）
